title: Registered Intel intrinsic names versus the complete Intel Intrinsics Guide

scope.claim: EquiLane currently registers 268 distinct Intel intrinsic names. This is not an implementation of every intrinsic in the Intel Intrinsics Guide, or even every SSE/SSE2 API name.
scope.meaning_of_registered: The exact API name is mapped to an official EquiLane case and its Intel C symbol. Name registration alone does not prove a complete signature, all inputs, all rounding modes, or conforming output on any target CPU.
scope.meaning_of_missing: The exact Guide API name has no registered official EquiLane case. This includes aliases, macros, MMX-related names, control/memory APIs, undefined-value APIs, and SVML library functions. Missing names are not necessarily distinct machine instructions.

reduced_bindings.name: _mm_sqrt_sd
reduced_bindings.note: The registered case passes the same vector as both Guide arguments and therefore covers a subset of this two-argument API.

scope.semantic_conformance: This audit compares names and factual API metadata only. It neither runs native code nor changes existing port-conformance findings.
scope.copyright_scope: Only API names, prototypes, short classification labels, counts, and source provenance are retained. Guide descriptions and Operation pseudocode are not reproduced.

counting_method.global_names: Deduplicate by the case-sensitive intrinsic name attribute before calculating registered and missing name counts.
counting_method.cpuid_rows: A name belongs to every CPUID label present on any of its Guide entries. Rows therefore overlap and must not be added to obtain the global total.
counting_method.technologies: Use the Guide tech attribute without interpreting it as a CPUID requirement. SVML is counted separately even where its CPUID label is SSE.
counting_method.duplicate_names: The Guide can contain the same API name for different requirement sets. The global missing-name list counts such a name only once.
counting_method.aliases_and_macros: No alias expansion or instruction-based matching is used. Every Guide name remains a separate API name.
counting_method.prototype_reconstruction: Join the XML return type, intrinsic name, and ordered parameter type/varname pairs; use void when there are no parameters.
counting_method.case_check: Statically extract CASE_YAML from all official case-pack files, then verify that every case Intel symbol maps to the catalog name. No model or native function is executed.
